create_list_marker_processor: create a ListItemMarkerProcessor to normalize various bullet and checkmark symbols in Docling documents
normalize_list_item_markers: normalize list item markers by converting unicode bullets and arrows to standard dash format
normalize_checkmark_symbols: normalize checkmark symbols like checkmarks and crosses to [x] in document text

normalize_text_symbols: normalize bullet, star, and checkmark symbols in arbitrary text strings
